versions.changelog:
**v2.2.0 brings major upgrades: now with 49-language syntax auto-detection and improved faithful indentation.**

- 49 programming languages auto-detected per file (by extension, name, or code content).
- Enhanced multi-language highlighting: advanced comment and string support, triple-quoted strings, annotation/directive highlight, tags, variables, and more.
- Faithful indentation: both brace and space-based (e.g., Python) indentation accurately preserved and rendered.
- Improved detection for ambiguous cases (`.m` files, Makefile/Dockerfile by name, etc.).
- Updated Python script and documentation for new capabilities.
- Added LICENSE and .gitignore; removed skill-card.md.
v2.0.5: fix version string to v2.0.5, replace raw HTML anchors with Markdown links for ClawHub compat
v2.0.4: fix GitHub anchor links - use pure Markdown headings for generate IDs
v2.0.3: GitHub-compatible bilingual docs (anchor links), remove raw HTML style/script tags
v2.0.2: 大括号深度缩进 + 标点自动换行 + 中英双语文档
v2.0.1: 完整中文说明文档，README 增加详细使用说明
v2.0: auto-fit to A4, 6 font choices (Cascadia/FiraCode/JetBrains/Consolas/Courier/SourceCode Pro), proper tab-stop handling, width truncation with indicator, auto lines-per-page calculation

- Initial release of "code-to-images" skill.
- Converts code files to syntax-highlighted, line-numbered A4-ratio images (SVG and PNG) with light theme.
- Generates one multipage PDF per source file, each page showing 50 lines of code in 14px Cascadia Code font.
- Output includes file name headers, per-page info, whitespace handling, and preserves code formatting.
- Requires Python 3, Node.js, @resvg/resvg-js, and img2pdf; usage and workflow detailed in SKILL.md.
